Moonshot Plans IPO in Six Months After China AI Breakthrough
videos.description: Moonshot AI has told investors it’s preparing to list in as early as six months, seizing the opportunity to tap capital markets after its latest model upended industry perceptions of China’s artificial intelligence capabilities and sent tech stocks reeling. Staying on IPO news, Jersey Mike’s Subs Inc. and its shareholders are looking to raise as much as $1.09 billion in an initial public offering, as consumer-oriented companies join the US listing rebound. videos.title: UN's Baerbock on Selecting New Secretary-General, Funding
videos.description: United Nations General Assembly President Annalena Baerbock says the UN faces a "decisive moment" with the selection of a new Secretary-General approaching. Speaking with Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg Open Interest," Baerbock also warns the UN could face a liquidity crisis.
